t: To carry out title V of the Older Americans Act of 1965, as amended, $436,678,000.

fable.w: This section is a bare appropriation of funds to carry out title V of the Older Americans Act. The tempting reading is that title V (community service employment for older Americans) involves outside parties, but the section itself sets up no consultation, comment period, hearing, advisory body, or right to sue. No party outside the federal government is brought into any federal decision.
fable.s: To carry out title V of the Older Americans Act of 1965, as amended, $436,678,000.

opus.w: This section only appropriates money to carry out an existing title of a statute. It sets up no comment period, hearing, advisory body, consultation with outside parties or right to sue. Any outside involvement in the underlying program comes from other provisions, not from this funding line.
opus.s: To carry out title V of the Older Americans Act of 1965, as amended, $436,678,000.
opus.b:
1. **Reasoning:** One might be tempted to say "Yes" because title V of the Older Americans Act runs a community service employment program that brings in outside groups. Nobody outside the federal government takes part in any federal decision here.
